$comment: Registry of the Railway project, its services and its environments.
THE ONLY PLACE IN THIS REPOSITORY WHERE A RAILWAY ID IS WRITTEN DOWN.
`railway-env.sh check` scans the whole tree and fails on a second copy,
because copies cannot disagree with the original and so never catch an
error - they only make it harder to correct. Read from here; the
workflows go through railway-config.yml, Python through load_project().
Services are addressed by ID: stable across a rename in the dashboard.
Environments are addressed by NAME, because the Railway CLI resolves
--environment by name only - passing an ID fails with
'Environment "<id>" not found'. If an environment is renamed in Railway,
The IDs below are for reference and for `railway-env.sh`, which addresses
environments by ID over the API. Both were WRONG until 2026-09-23 and
nothing caught it, so they are re-derived from the dashboard, not copied:
open the project URL, switch the environment dropdown, and read
environmentId= out of the address bar. A service ID appears in the URL
